title: muhlenbergia commutata
intro: Muhlenbergia commutata, commonly known as Cotton-Grass, is a type of grass native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is a flowering plant that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of digestive issues and inflammation. The health benefits of Muhlenbergia commutata include its ability to soothe digestive problems, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
